judgment.notes: M005 is instantiated with X=R, G=measures on R, nu=lambda, countable subtype T of N, and W(i)=J_i. D009 supplies a measure, hence the required function-like outer-measure structure; countability follows from T⊆N. Its displayed signature requires no measurability. Its conclusion is precisely the union bound in S003. N001 is applied to the real interval at positive exponents a>1 and 0<s<1, using its H=0 and H=infinity dimension consequences. The routine facts below have their required signs, boundedness and nonnegativity available.

For a>1 the equal-interval covers have mesh 1/N and cost N^(1-a)→0, proving vanishing content at every fixed scale and hence H^a(I)=0. For each lower-estimate cover, the enlarged intervals yield sum rho_i≥1 by M005 and arbitrary epsilon. The pointwise power inequality gives every cover cost at least delta^(s-1), including zero-diameter members. Taking the infimum and then the supremum over scales yields H^s(I)=infinity because s<1. N001 and real-order approximation from either side of 1 prove the exact equality. No limit is interchanged with a sum or infimum.
